bio.text: Joe Lombardo, a Republican, has been governor of Nevada since January 2023 and is the Republican nominee for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was elected Clark County sheriff in 2014 and re-elected in 2018, after 26 years with the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department.
He earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree in crisis management from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and served in the U.S. Army and the Nevada National Guard.
